title: The Mughal Assault on Ram Rauni Begins

blocks.text: The building of Ram Rauni is answered almost immediately by siege. When news reaches the Mughal side, Mir Mannu dispatches Dina Beg with Kaura Mal, Sadiq Beg, Aziz Khan, artillery, and allied hill forces to crush the Sikh concentration before it can settle into strength.

Inside the fort, the Khalsa understands that the enemy is numerically heavier and better supplied. The defenders still choose open resistance, sending out small bands ready for martyrdom rather than accepting confinement as a slow surrender.

The page also begins the technical struggle of siege warfare. As the attackers push forward and prepare covered approaches, the Singhs answer by using the channel and defensive works around Ram Rauni to blunt the first Mughal pressure.
